name: Balanced Spherical Grid
definition: A discretized angular and radial grid structure used to represent radiance fields for egocentric view synthesis, consisting of two grids (Yin and Yang) to handle spherical parameterization.
summary: The Balanced Spherical Grid is a neural volume representation for egocentric view synthesis that avoids polar singularities by combining two offset spherical grids and handles unbounded scenes via exponential radial partitioning.
